subject: [PATCH v5 2/8] mm/gup: break out gup_flush_pages() helper

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch breaks out the cache flushing code from the __get_user_pages() function into a new helper function called gup_flush_pages(). The helper function takes in the number of pages and their addresses, and flushes each page's caches. This change is intended to improve code organization and maintainability without introducing any functional changes.
